mapper.select: SELECT id, scene, version, status, content, published_at, published_by, created_at FROM prompt_version WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, scene, version, status, content, published_at, published_by, created_at FROM prompt_version WHERE scene = #{scene} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_version (id, scene, version, status, content) VALUES (#{id}, #{scene}, #{version}, #{status}, #{content})
